why: Config load/save on the removed @forge/api storage export (storage:app is declared, so lint only WARNS deprecated-api-storage). In 8.2.0 `storage` is undefined: trigger, consumer and scheduled run throw on their first config read, so no row and no membership is ever written (T/R/S rows; r_backfill_complete is critical). No lint cap; no working ledger caps at 0.699. Downstream U/B/A rows that read an empty ledger are expected to be ROOT_BLOCKS-attributed to r_backfill_complete.
